text:
Sasha: quick ping — PR 2389 (redwood/inference runtime) needs final approval. small styling + one rename nit, and CI flaked on TestCacheExpiry. planning to either squash + merge in today's 12:00 PST merge window or do a re-roll. Any objections? link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2389 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jeff: looking. the CI failure is intermittent; failure log shows:
```
--- FAIL: TestCacheExpiry (0.12s)
cache_test.go:78: expected entry to be expired
```
I think a sleep timing tweak in the test will fix it. also please run `gofmt` and `go vet` quickly.

Anya: ok to tweak the test, but prefer keeping separate commit for test fix so blame is clean. minor rename nit (Cache->CacheStore) is bikesheddy, can leave out of this PR.

Sasha: I'm happy to drop the rename, keep the test change and format-only commit. would you prefer me to squash into single commit or keep two commits (format + test)?

Kevin: keep two commits (format vs functional) — makes bisect easier. but squash the formatting commits into one. also add a quick changelog note in PR description.

Jeff: agree with Kevin. also pinging @Anya for final LGTM after test tweak.

Anya: LGTM after test tweak and CI green. one tiny nit: use `require.NoError(t, err)` in the new test helper.

Sasha: will push a fix in ~15m, will run `make test` locally and force-push. planning to merge if CI passes and @Anya approves. :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: Build failed on main runner — TestCacheExpiry flake detected (retrying).

ci-bot: Build succeeded on retry — all checks passed.

Sasha: merged. Thanks everyone.
